introduction_raw:
[youtubevideo|KSGgP1YjzuA]This guide shows how to change the six spark plugs in a 2018–2024 Jeep Wrangler (JL) equipped with the 3.6 L Pentastar V6.

The 3.6 L V6 hides its spark plugs beneath the plastic intake manifold, so routine ignition service can look intimidating. This guide walks you through safe manifold removal, correct torque procedures, and every connection that must be unplugged and re‑seated. Follow along to restore smooth idle, fuel economy, and performance whenever misfires appear or factory mileage intervals are reached.
introduction_rendered:
This guide shows how to change the six spark plugs in a 2018–2024 Jeep Wrangler (JL) equipped with the 3.6 L Pentastar V6.

The 3.6 L V6 hides its spark plugs beneath the plastic intake manifold, so routine ignition service can look intimidating. This guide walks you through safe manifold removal, correct torque procedures, and every connection that must be unplugged and re‑seated. Follow along to restore smooth idle, fuel economy, and performance whenever misfires appear or factory mileage intervals are reached.

parts.text: Intake Manifold Gasket Set: 2018–2024 Jeep Wrangler JL 3.6L V6

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|0|25.2]Use a 10 mm socket and ratchet to loosen the nut on the negative battery post.
lines.text_rendered: Use a 10 mm socket and ratchet to loosen the nut on the negative battery post.

lines.text_raw: Wiggle the cable free and set it aside where it cannot contact the terminal.
lines.text_rendered: Wiggle the cable free and set it aside where it cannot contact the terminal.

lines.text_raw: Never allow the disconnected cable to touch the positive post or metal tools.
lines.text_rendered: Never allow the disconnected cable to touch the positive post or metal tools.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|32|139.4]Remove the two 10 mm bolts that hold the air box to the fender.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the two 10 mm bolts that hold the air box to the fender.

lines.text_raw: Loosen the 8 mm hose clamp at the throttle body until the tube rotates freely.
lines.text_rendered: Loosen the 8 mm hose clamp at the throttle body until the tube rotates freely.

lines.text_raw: Squeeze the spring clamp and disconnect the small breather hose from the tube.
lines.text_rendered: Squeeze the spring clamp and disconnect the small breather hose from the tube.

lines.text_raw: Pull upward to release the three push‑clips and lift the snorkel and air box out.
lines.text_rendered: Pull upward to release the three push‑clips and lift the snorkel and air box out.

steps.title: Disconnect throttle body connector and vacuum line

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|154.6|197.5]Slide the red lock on the throttle body connector rearward to unlock it.
lines.text_rendered: Slide the red lock on the throttle body connector rearward to unlock it.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|154.6|197.5]Depress the tab and unplug the throttle body wiring harness.
lines.text_rendered: Depress the tab and unplug the throttle body wiring harness.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|154.6|197.5]Disconnect the vacuum hose at the rear of the intake by pressing its release tab and pulling back.
lines.text_rendered: Disconnect the vacuum hose at the rear of the intake by pressing its release tab and pulling back.

steps.title: Release wiring harness clips from manifold

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|197.5|279.4]Use a trim‑clip removal tool to pop off the Christmas‑tree fasteners securing the harness to the manifold.
lines.text_rendered: Use a trim‑clip removal tool to pop off the Christmas‑tree fasteners securing the harness to the manifold.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|197.5|279.4]Work along the top and side of the manifold until every clip is free.
lines.text_rendered: Work along the top and side of the manifold until every clip is free.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|197.5|279.4]Keep the harness and lines clear of the manifold so they will not snag during removal.
lines.text_rendered: Keep the harness and lines clear of the manifold so they will not snag during removal.

steps.title: Remove foam insulator and cover hooks

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|297.4|358.9]Pry out the push‑clips and lift away the black foam insulator sitting on top of the manifold.
lines.text_rendered: Pry out the push‑clips and lift away the black foam insulator sitting on top of the manifold.

lines.text_raw: Remove the two 10 mm bolts that hold the plastic engine‑cover hooks if you do not plan to reuse them.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the two 10 mm bolts that hold the plastic engine‑cover hooks if you do not plan to reuse them.

steps.title: Detach AC line bracket and plate

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|463.1|493.8]Remove the four 10 mm bolts securing the metal bracket that carries the AC line and wiring on the right head.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the four 10 mm bolts securing the metal bracket that carries the AC line and wiring on the right head.

lines.text_raw: Set the bracket aside to expose the remaining intake manifold fasteners.
lines.text_rendered: Set the bracket aside to expose the remaining intake manifold fasteners.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|493.8|574.3]Break all seven 10 mm manifold bolts loose with a small ratchet; they are only tightened to 8–9 N·m.
lines.text_rendered: Break all seven 10 mm manifold bolts loose with a small ratchet; they are only tightened to 8–9 N·m.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|493.8|574.3]Note that the upper row uses long bolts and the lower row uses short bolts.
lines.text_rendered: Note that the upper row uses long bolts and the lower row uses short bolts.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|493.8|574.3]Reach the hidden rear‑corner bolt with a wobble extension.
lines.text_rendered: Reach the hidden rear‑corner bolt with a wobble extension.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|493.8|574.3]Remove each bolt and leave them in the manifold to avoid dropping them.
lines.text_rendered: Remove each bolt and leave them in the manifold to avoid dropping them.

steps.title: Lift the intake manifold and cover ports

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|574.3|706.7]Rock the manifold upward, guiding the bolts past the bracket and fuel rail.
lines.text_rendered: Rock the manifold upward, guiding the bolts past the bracket and fuel rail.

lines.text_raw: Watch the rear EVAP hose; disconnect it if it becomes taut.
lines.text_rendered: Watch the rear EVAP hose; disconnect it if it becomes taut.

lines.text_raw: Lift the manifold clear of the engine and set it safely on the bench.
lines.text_rendered: Lift the manifold clear of the engine and set it safely on the bench.

lines.text_raw: Cover all exposed intake ports with clean rags to keep dirt and hardware out.
lines.text_rendered: Cover all exposed intake ports with clean rags to keep dirt and hardware out.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|706.7|775.7]Press the tab on each coil connector and unplug it from the coil.
lines.text_rendered: Press the tab on each coil connector and unplug it from the coil.

lines.text_raw: Remove the coil hold‑down screw with an 8 mm socket.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the coil hold‑down screw with an 8 mm socket.

lines.text_raw: Wiggle and pull the coil straight upward to break the seal and remove it.
lines.text_rendered: Wiggle and pull the coil straight upward to break the seal and remove it.

lines.text_raw: Store the coils somewhere clean so the rubber boots stay undamaged.
lines.text_rendered: Store the coils somewhere clean so the rubber boots stay undamaged.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|775.7|839.6]Secure a 5/8‑inch spark plug socket to an extension with tape so it cannot detach inside the well.
lines.text_rendered: Secure a 5/8‑inch spark plug socket to an extension with tape so it cannot detach inside the well.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|775.7|839.6]Seat the socket on the spark plug and turn counter‑clockwise until the threads are free.
lines.text_rendered: Seat the socket on the spark plug and turn counter‑clockwise until the threads are free.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|775.7|839.6]Retrieve the plug with the socket or a magnetic pick‑up tool if it stays in the well.
lines.text_rendered: Retrieve the plug with the socket or a magnetic pick‑up tool if it stays in the well.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|840|910.7]Apply a thin film of dielectric grease to the threads of each new plug if desired.
lines.text_rendered: Apply a thin film of dielectric grease to the threads of each new plug if desired.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|840|910.7]Hand‑thread the new plug into the head using the taped extension to avoid cross‑threading.
lines.text_rendered: Hand‑thread the new plug into the head using the taped extension to avoid cross‑threading.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|840|910.7]Torque the plug to ***13 ft‑lb*** (144 in‑lb) until the torque wrench clicks.
lines.text_rendered: Torque the plug to 13 ft‑lb (144 in‑lb) until the torque wrench clicks.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|910.7|979.9]Push each coil fully onto its plug until it bottoms out.
lines.text_rendered: Push each coil fully onto its plug until it bottoms out.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|910.7|979.9]Install the hold‑down screw and torque to ***84 in‑lb*** using a criss‑cross pattern.
lines.text_rendered: Install the hold‑down screw and torque to 84 in‑lb using a criss‑cross pattern.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|910.7|979.9]Reattach every coil connector and confirm each latch clicks.
lines.text_rendered: Reattach every coil connector and confirm each latch clicks.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|979.9|993.8]Remove the rags from the intake ports and inspect the gasket for nicks; replace if damaged.
lines.text_rendered: Remove the rags from the intake ports and inspect the gasket for nicks; replace if damaged.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|979.9|993.8]Guide the manifold onto the dowels and lower it evenly into place.
lines.text_rendered: Guide the manifold onto the dowels and lower it evenly into place.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|979.9|993.8]Start the long upper and short lower bolts by hand.
lines.text_rendered: Start the long upper and short lower bolts by hand.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|979.9|993.8]Torque each bolt to ***8–9 N·m*** following an even center‑out pattern.
lines.text_rendered: Torque each bolt to 8–9 N·m following an even center‑out pattern.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|993.8|1015.2]Reinstall the AC line bracket and torque its four 10 mm bolts.
lines.text_rendered: Reinstall the AC line bracket and torque its four 10 mm bolts.

lines.text_raw: Snap every wiring harness clip and vacuum hose back into its original location.
lines.text_rendered: Snap every wiring harness clip and vacuum hose back into its original location.

lines.text_raw: Plug the throttle body connector back in and push the red lock fully home.
lines.text_rendered: Plug the throttle body connector back in and push the red lock fully home.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|1015.2|1032.2]Position the air box and snorkel, aligning the three locating pins with the radiator shroud.
lines.text_rendered: Position the air box and snorkel, aligning the three locating pins with the radiator shroud.

lines.text_raw: Tighten the two 10 mm air box bolts and the 8 mm throttle body hose clamp.
lines.text_rendered: Tighten the two 10 mm air box bolts and the 8 mm throttle body hose clamp.

lines.text_raw: Reconnect the breather hose and ensure its spring clamp is seated.
lines.text_rendered: Reconnect the breather hose and ensure its spring clamp is seated.

lines.text_raw: [youtubetimestamp|1055.2|1065.2]Reattach the negative battery cable and tighten the 10 mm nut.
lines.text_rendered: Reattach the negative battery cable and tighten the 10 mm nut.

lines.text_raw: Start the engine and listen for vacuum leaks or misfires.
lines.text_rendered: Start the engine and listen for vacuum leaks or misfires.

lines.text_raw: If everything sounds normal, clear any stored codes and take a short test drive.
lines.text_rendered: If everything sounds normal, clear any stored codes and take a short test drive.
